_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
On Macs, recording uses Command shortcuts and the palette shows matching hints. navigator.platform is "MacIntel", so the record-audio shortcut is press_key "M" with modifiers "Meta+Shift" and the record-screen shortcut press_key "M" with modifiers "Meta+Alt+Shift". The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". "The palette item X" is the command palette item whose title is exactly X; select it with '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="X"]' (the page keeps that attribute equal to the item's title). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. The voice button should be enabled.
2. Press "k" with modifier "Meta". The command palette input (".command-palette-input") should become visible; fill it with "Record audio".
3. The "kbd" of the palette item "Record audio" should have the text exactly "⌘⇧M", and the "kbd" of the palette item "Record audio and screen" the text exactly "⌘⌥⇧M".
4. Press Escape in the palette input.
5. Press the record-audio shortcut. The recording panel should get data-mode "microphone" and the recording state should become "recording". Click the cancel button; the voice button should be enabled.
6. Press the record-screen shortcut. The recording panel should get data-mode "screen" and the recording state should become "recording". Click the cancel button; the voice button should be enabled.
7. window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts must be 2 and window.__recordingMock.synchronousDisplayRequests must be 1.
